features.text: TARGETED PATELLA CONTROL: Horseshoe design with patella opening centers and stabilizes the kneecap to relieve tracking pain.
CUSTOM COMPRESSION ZONE: Removable donut padding and repositionable hook patches let you fine-tune pressure where needed.
BREATHABLE THERAPEUTIC WARMTH: Comfortable materials help reduce stiffness while allowing airflow for all-day wear.
TRIMMABLE, UNIVERSAL FIT: Cut-to-fit thigh and calf panels and adjustable straps create a secure fit on the left or right knee.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PDAC APPROVED A4467: Eligible for insurance reimbursement (check with your provider).
